Legal & Compliance Breakdown

Contractor Hiring vs Misclassification: Independent Consultancy Agreement or EOR. Classification risk has not been independently assessed. Historical note: Not assessed.
Intellectual Property (IP) Protection: Indian Copyright Act requires express written assignment. US companies must ensure a clear, written IP assignment clause is executed in accordance with local labor and civil code.
Recommended Employer of Record (EOR): An EOR does not remove every employment risk. Research provider options with local advice. Historical provider reference: Deel / Multiplier ($300/mo).
